releases.description: Flash+ now includes the complete fifteen-table QuickQ arcade, live table chat and spectating, a rebuilt Social Chat with usernames, public channels, Reels, and Live, a softer visual polish, the rebuilt Eaglercraft launcher, and first-run terms.

changes.text: Added QuickQ, a fifteen-game arcade with Connect 4, Battleship, Uno, Chess, Checkers, Reversi, Dominoes, Blackjack, Crazy Eights, Memory, Tic-Tac-Toe, Mancala, Go Fish, Dots & Boxes, and Nim. Every table has custom artwork and can be played with bots or a friend.

QuickQ opens game-first: choose a table, pick two to four seats where supported, set ranked or casual play, and fill empty chairs with bots. Uno, Dominoes, Blackjack, Crazy Eights, Go Fish, and Memory support 2–4 seats; the rest are two-player tables.
QuickQ includes direct peer rooms, bot turns, multiplayer card hands, table chat, voice chat, read-only spectating, and a device-local rating that starts at 500.

Rebuilt Chat under Social around usernames instead of room codes. Choose a username once, then join automatically created public channels for general chat, gaming, creative work, and help. Other people can find and privately message you by that username.
Added text and voice chat with typing notes, online presence, unread counts, and private messages. Channel voice calls connect people directly in the browser.

Added Reels: share a short video up to 15 MB and three minutes with everyone in a channel, watch it in a focused player, and leave likes or views. Videos are cached on your device and sent directly between people, with no Firebase or video backend.

Added Live: share a game or screen with channel members in a low-latency peer connection, with the channel chat beside the video. Streams support up to six viewers and are built for small channel hangs, not public broadcasts.
Polished Flash+ while keeping its soft, rounded shell: a customizable accent that tints the page background, soft fills and highlights, calmer surfaces, and warm orange as the default accent.
About:blank cloaking no longer draws a visible Leave button; Shift+End still clears the cloaked session.
Added Terms & Conditions and a Privacy Policy in a compact tabbed reader. First-time visitors must read and accept them before using the app, and can review them again from Settings.
Cloud navigation is now fully delegated to the Flash API. The app no longer adds its own retry budget, relay benchmark, or URL-change handling on top of nowgg's launcher.
Cached games now retain their original document base URL, so Ruffle player scripts, relative game assets and SWFs resolve from the provider instead of the app shell.
Support & feedback opens the embedded feedback form, and the privacy policy explains the form provider’s role in processing responses.
Downloads that need a proxy now use fp.js first: the tunnel is lazy-loaded after direct and CDN paths fail, then the legacy relay engine remains as a last resort.
Renamed the launcher-first interface from Nova to Flash+ everywhere in the app and Settings.
The Flash+ top bar now rests 40px from the top of the viewport, and its condensed state is a real pill instead of a misshapen strip.
Social is now a true fullscreen tab, and the nav bar automatically condenses into its pill state when you open it.

Rebuilt the Eaglercraft launcher: a readable version library on the left, a large selected-build panel on the right, cleaner filters, search, sorting and one-click play, install, favorite and remove actions.

Game Mode was rebuilt from the ground up with 17 widget types: FPS, frame time, memory, connection, keystrokes, input stats, controller, clock, date, session timer, stopwatch, battery, now playing, Confer, plus your own notes, counters and links.
Every widget is now yours to shape: rename it, swap its icon, pick a look (solid, outline, ghost, accent or light) and tune size, opacity, corners and accent colour per widget.
Create your own widgets in the editor — a note pinned over the game, a tap counter for deaths and wins, or a one-tap link — then drag everything exactly where you want it.
About:blank cloaking now loads the entire app into the blank window: markup, styles and all five scripts are inlined. Nothing is framed, and games, packs and assets still load normally.
Cloaking finally opens its own window instead of a tab — every launch uses a fresh window name and a real popup feature string, so browsers stop retargeting the old tab.
Cloud games now show the regional host immediately (including 24.ip.nowgg.fun) and correct themselves in the background, instead of waiting on slow probes and then framing the wrong host.
Cloud sessions now count towards your stats, Restart works for them, and a status pill says when a host is unreachable instead of leaving a silent blank frame.
The app shell cache was refreshed so every device picks up 5.4.4 properly.

releases.description: Game Mode, the new Operations admin deck, and cloak everywhere.

changes.text: Added some new games
Added a new, dedicated 1.21 SuperEfficient Optimized EaglerCraft client. Its extremely fast and now completely compatible with Flash Games.
Added the first WebPorts to Flash Games! Expect more to come.
Added a better Discord tab to talk with Discord users
Added an Articles section! Learn more about the behind-the-scenes about Flash Games & more.
Fix Confer from being soo laggy.
Fixed some devices still not supporting confer locally

GAME MODE has landed! Build your own in-game HUD in Settings: FPS, keystrokes, clock, session timer, Confer and battery widgets — place them anywhere by dragging, and open it all inside any game with a shortcut you choose.
The Admin section was deleted and rebuilt from zero. It is now an Operations deck with bans, kicks, timed suspensions, a global shutdown switch and a full member console.
Cloaking in a new window finally works on every browser — Safari and Chrome on macOS included. If the custom window is refused it silently falls back to a plain blank window instead of doing nothing.
Game Mode widgets now receive keystrokes and clicks from all kinds of games, including ones that run inside their own embedded frames.
Older changelog entries were retired. The app shell cache was refreshed so every device picks up 5.4.3 properly.

articles.title: Introducing: 5.4.3
articles.subtitle: A massive Flash Games update — new games, a faster EaglerCraft client, WebPorts, Discord improvements, and more.
articles.author: Flash Games Team

hero.caption: Flash Games 5.4.3 — a massive update with plenty of new things to explore.

articles.introduction: It's finally here! Flash Games 5.4.3 is a massive update packed with new features, performance improvements, and more ways to enjoy Flash Games. From a dedicated, optimized EaglerCraft client to our first WebPorts and a brand-new Articles section, there's a lot to explore. Here's everything that's new.

sections.text: New Games, New Ways to Play

We've added some new games to Flash Games! Whether you're looking for something new to try or just want another game to add to your rotation, there's more to explore. Head over to the games section and see what's waiting for you.
A Faster EaglerCraft Experience

One of the biggest additions in 5.4.3 is a dedicated SuperEfficient Optimized EaglerCraft client for Minecraft 1.21. It's designed to be extremely fast and is now completely compatible with Flash Games.

This gives players a dedicated way to jump into EaglerCraft while benefiting from the optimization work behind the new client. If you've been waiting for a better EaglerCraft experience on Flash Games, this is one of the highlights of the update.
Introducing WebPorts
Flash Games now has its first WebPorts! This marks the beginning of something new for the platform, bringing more possibilities for what can be added in the future.
This is only the beginning. Expect more WebPorts to come!
sections.author: Flash Games Team

sections.text: We're excited to see where WebPorts go from here. Keep an eye out for future additions as the collection grows.
A Better Discord Tab
We've added an improved Discord tab to make it easier to talk with Discord users. It's another step toward making Flash Games more than just a place to play games — it's a place to connect, too.
Introducing the Articles Section
You're reading it right now! Version 5.4.3 introduces a brand-new Articles section where you can learn more about Flash Games, its development, behind-the-scenes details, new features, and much more.

Instead of keeping everything behind the scenes, we now have a dedicated place to share updates, explain what we're working on, and give you a closer look at the platform. Expect more articles as Flash Games continues to evolve.
Confer Improvements
We've also made improvements to Confer, focusing on two important issues that could get in the way of using it.

items.detail: Fixed issues that were making Confer excessively laggy, improving the overall experience.
Fixed issues that prevented Confer from working locally on some devices.

sections.text: These fixes should make Confer more usable for affected players and help provide a smoother, more reliable experience across supported devices.
Everything New in 5.4.3

items.detail: More games have been added to the Flash Games collection.
A dedicated, extremely fast client that is now completely compatible with Flash Games.
The first WebPorts have arrived, with more planned for the future.
A better way to talk with Discord users.
Discover behind-the-scenes information, platform updates, and more.
Fixed excessive lag affecting Confer.
Fixed local compatibility issues on some devices.

sections.text: What's Next?

Version 5.4.3 is a big step forward for Flash Games. With new games, a dedicated optimized EaglerCraft client, the arrival of WebPorts, an improved Discord tab, and the launch of Articles, there's more to discover than ever.
And we're not stopping here. More WebPorts and more improvements are on the horizon. Thank you for playing, exploring, and being part of Flash Games!
Flash Games 5.4.3 is here, and it's a massive one. Jump in, try the new features, explore the Articles section, and see what's new for yourself. We'll see you in Flash Games!

articles.title: Introducing: Flash v5.4
articles.subtitle: Everything in the newest update. Monumental changes.
articles.author: Flash

hero.caption: Version 5.4 — The most ambitious update since launch

articles.introduction: After three months of intensive development, Flash Games 5.4 lands today. This isn't just an incremental patch — it's a fundamental rebuild of how the platform works. We've added a full Eaglercraft launcher with 15+ Minecraft versions, built Confer from scratch for peer-to-peer video calls, integrated cloud gaming via nowgg.fun, and rewrote the entire game installation pipeline. Here's the complete breakdown.

sections.text: Eaglercraft: A Complete Launcher Built In
We've built a full Eaglercraft launcher, from scratch, to suit your gaming needs. From 1.8 to 26.3, we have nearly every version you'll ever need.

items: Custom clients — Pixel Client (1.8.8, 1.12.2), Tuff Client (WASM), Astra Client, Resent Client 5.0, ShadowNet Client

sections.text: Every client downloads once via our new install engine, then runs completely offline. No accounts, no telemetry, no data collection. The WASM builds are heavyweight (~50-120MB), but after the first launch they start instantly.
Confer: Peer-to-Peer Video Calls, No Servers
Confer is our new communication service that you can use during games & even out of them. Create & join rooms, plus do more. All features are:
Core Features

items.detail: Camera/mic toggle, device selection, mirror preview
Share entire screen, window, or browser tab with audio
Text chat with file attachments (images, videos, documents)
Simple 6-16 character alphanumeric codes for private rooms
DTLS-SRTP for media, encrypted data channels for messages
Share entire files over Confer's messaging service

sections.text: Confer lives in the Social tab and stays connected across route changes — your calls survive tab switches. It also works if the person on the other end is playing a game, with a dedicated view while your playing any game. Activate it in the notch.
Cloud Gaming
Verified accounts and developer codes now unlock 12 cloud titles streamed via our providers. You can play games ranging from Roblox, Rocket League, or even Fortnite.

items: Regional routing — automatic host detection per region
Connection badges — know when a game is working or not
Numbered grid — consistent ordering across sessions
Queue to play & get in fast

sections.text: Architecture Rebuild: libcurl Relay & Offline-First
We now use a new, built-in and integrated game loader & fetcher which is 2x faster & more efficent for all games.
Key Improvements

items: Installs reuse cached games instead of re-downloading every time
Mega bundles: 'The Whole Vault', 'Every Offline Game', 'Every Online Game' for quick game access ofline
Always running the latest-version of Flash
Game HUD no longer drifts on hover
Unified Games section: Library + Store merged with centered switcher

sections.text: Optimization
Along with thousands of games, cloud games, and Eaglercraft versions, comes lag and latency. Our new optimization systems help out with this:

items: Motion — enables/disables all interface animations, but keeps games running crisp on your GPU (unless game doesn't allow it)
Performance Mode — reduces visual effects, disables blur/glass while gaming, offloading all useless elements for performance.

sections.text: Both persist in localStorage and apply instantly without reload.
Thanks for reading! Go and treat yourself to some Eaglercraft.

articles.title: Say Hello to Confer
articles.subtitle: Learn more about Confer & connecting with others during play
articles.author: Flash
articles.introduction: Learn more about how to use Confer and how it works

sections.text: What is Confer?
Confer is Flash Games way of communicating with your friends while playing. Confer is integrated in the following platforms:

items: While playing a game via the Social button in the options notch (Social Game Overlay)

sections.text: All platforms that Confer is supported on can connect with eachother, meaning you can connect with your friend via the Social tab, but they can be using the social game overlay. Always make sure your version of Confer and Flash Games are on the latest update.
How does it work?

Your devices create a WebRTC connection to eachother and send encrypted data packets to eachother. They are end-to-end encrypted. If required, your router will forward the packets if the distance between both devices is too far for your devices to send the information. You may recieve some lag because encoding and decoding encrypted data packets takes some time without a server. We do not currently nor plan to use a server to store your information. Not only that, Confer offers the following services:

items.detail: Camera/mic toggle, device selection, mirror preview
Share entire screen, window, or browser tab with audio
Text chat with file attachments (images, videos, documents)
Simple 6-16 character alphanumeric codes for private rooms
DTLS-SRTP for media, encrypted data channels for messages
Share entire files over Confer's messaging service
